title: Ambient lighting themes and door handle lighting
summary: Feedback centers on ambient lighting themes and door handle lighting, with clear praise for lighting presentation but many examples that are too incomplete or ambiguous to classify confidently.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the lighting modes, themes, and ambient lighting as attractive design features, with one also wishing for more downloadable themes.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention programming exterior door handle lighting, missing door handle lighting, updated lighting features, switching ambient lighting off, and the lighting stalk, but the examples are too incomplete or ambiguous to classify reliably.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are labeled undetermined, limiting confidence in a clear sentiment pattern beyond the explicit praise.
The cluster mixes several lighting-related subjects, including ambient themes, exterior door handle lighting, and lighting controls, rather than one single coherent issue.
Some fragments are too brief or lack context to determine whether the reviewer is praising, criticizing, or simply describing the feature.
